title: Surface Atelier/CKC/PoseKit/Ingest settings-options features in the operator settings surface
origin: MT-040 audit P5 (out of MT-006 scope) + operator goal directive 'make sure the options/settings has the correct features for this wp'.

scope.summary: Ensure the operator settings/options surface carries the correct features for this WP: Atelier + CKC + PoseKit + Ingest. Backend atelier settings already exist (src/backend/handshake_core/src/atelier/settings.rs). This MT locates the native settings/options surface in handshake_native and surfaces/verifies the WP's operator-configurable features with runtime proof.
candidate_settings: PoseKit framing/lens defaults, marker layer toggles
Any atelier/settings.rs backend keys not yet surfaced to the operator
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Locate the operator settings/options surface in handshake_native and enumerate which Atelier/CKC/PoseKit/Ingest settings should be operator-configurable (reconcile against atelier/settings.rs backend keys).

AC2: Surface the correct WP settings features in that operator settings surface with stable author_ids, persisted through the product's PostgreSQL/EventLedger authority (no SQLite), round-trip proven at runtime.
AC3: Argus inspect + steer the settings controls headlessly (HBR-VIS/QUIET); expand Argus if any settings control cannot be seen/steered.
AC4: Update the in-product internal UserManual for the settings features (HBR-MAN).
AC5: No scaffolding; runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate); LLM-first/PostgreSQL-authoritative data posture.

hbr_obligations_note: HBR-VIS (Argus), HBR-QUIET (headless), HBR-MAN (UserManual), HBR-INT (PostgreSQL/EventLedger persistence), HBR-SWARM (parallel-agent addressability).

lifecycle.claim_recovery_reason: Status recovery: legacy RFV contract lacked lifecycle.claimed_by; Kernel Builder inspected current MT state and accepts implementer-side handoff responsibility without claiming validator PASS/FAIL.

candidate_reconciliation: Implemented Settings / Defaults as 13 PostgreSQL/EventLedger-backed operator default preferences: atelier-ui.landing-tab, ckc.book-mode, posekit framing/lens/padding/marker defaults, ingest.batch-tags, and ingest.default-policy.

CKC media backend mode and actor remain implemented as operational CKC media controls/readouts (`atelier-ckc-media-backend-mode`, `atelier-ckc-media-actor`) because backend mode is derived from live persistence availability and actor identity is per-write attribution, not a global default preference.
Ingest event/date/location defaults are represented by the configurable `ingest.batch-tags` default rather than separate persisted preference keys in this MT.

Prompt-feedback settings/defaults were not part of MT-042's declared Atelier + CKC + PoseKit + Ingest settings scope; prompt-feedback workflow/options are covered by MT-020, MT-051, and MT-052 operational surfaces and manual coverage.
residual_validator_focus: Validator should confirm whether the candidate-to-implemented preference reconciliation is acceptable or should become a new MT after official review.
No official validation is claimed; lifecycle.validator_verdict remains PENDING.

legacy_rfv_evidence.summary: Committed 22a4ec8f (2026-07-02): 13 operator-default preferences on the existing atelier PG+EventLedger preference store (landing-tab, ckc.book-mode, posekit framing/lens/padding/markers, ingest tags/policy); routes GET/PUT/POST /atelier/preferences(+reset); backend_client; collapsing Settings/Defaults region in atelier_panel.rs (not a 4th tab, avoids editor-WIP settings_dialog.rs); Argus atelier-settings-*; UserManual. Candidate reconciliation: CKC media backend mode/actor stayed as operational CKC media controls/readouts (`atelier-ckc-media-backend-mode`, `atelier-ckc-media-actor`) because mode is derived from live persistence availability and actor is per-write attribution, not a global default; Ingest event/date/location defaults are represented by ingest.batch-tags; prompt-feedback defaults are outside MT-042 and covered by MT-020/051/052 workflow surfaces. Adversarial review found+fixed: mock-consuming load-on-open regression, F1 non-atomic save, F2 tab-yank, F3 dead padding, F4 actor attribution, F5-F8. Runtime-proven: test_atelier_panel 29/1 (1=pre-existing MT-016) + 4 unit tests; backend atelier_settings_preference_tests 3/3 on managed PG. Security finding: EventLedger redacts preference values to sha256 refs. F6 note: enum fields kept as steerable TextInputs + client validation (combos would break argus.set_value TextInput-only). No official validation is claimed; validator_verdict remains PENDING.
legacy_rfv_evidence.note: Evidence summary copied into the MT contract for implementer-side checklist recovery only; this is not an official validator verdict.
